issues.title: TLS 1.1 is still offered
issues.detail: The server accepted a TLS 1.1 handshake (TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA). TLS 1.0 and 1.1 were deprecated in 2021 and have no post-quantum path. Disable them.

issues.title: TLS 1.2 is still offered
issues.detail: The server accepted a TLS 1.2-only handshake (TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256). TLS 1.2 has no post-quantum key exchange, so any session that lands on it has no quantum protection. Disable it once your clients allow.

issues.title: Certificate authentication is classical (ECDSA P-256)
issues.detail: The certificate and its chain use classical signatures. That is expected: browsers don't yet trust post-quantum certificates from public CAs, and signatures can't be broken retroactively, so there is nothing to do yet.
